column1: # One verdict per published API item. `gates api-coverage` holds this,
# testdata/api-surface.json and the code to each other, and runs in
# A `method` is an API method. A `request` is a member of the Sheets
# batchUpdate union — the axis that matters here, because this API
# publishes seventeen methods and sixty-nine request kinds inside one
# of them, and the union is where Google adds capability.
# `used` names the code that implements it. `out` says why this server
# does not call it. A `*` row stands for the rest of one API and may
# only say `out`; Drive has one, because §1 puts file management in a
# server built on the Drive API rather than this one.
